Card.Name: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry Service
Card.Description: This service handles Windows telemetry and connected-user-experience data collection. Disabling it reduces diagnostic and usage reporting, but some connected-experience features can lose functionality.
Card.FriendlyDescription: This service handles Windows telemetry and connected-user-experience data collection. Disabling it reduces diagnostic and usage reporting, but some connected-experience features can lose functionality.
Card.WhatWeKnowSummary: Claim: This service handles Windows telemetry and connected-user-experience data collection. Disabling it reduces diagnostic and usage reporting, but some connected-experience features can lose functionality. Evidence: The Microsoft services guidance page explicitly lists the DiagTrack service, its Automatic baseline, its telemetry role, and that it is OK to disable.
